note_text: Spent the morning thanking TradingView and the afternoon proving why. The free screener I built on their data does factor scoring, z-scores, and 47 scans for $0. The paid analyst reads options flow for $7.99. Different jobs, not better and worse.
Stop paying for a screener before you try the free one. scanline runs on TradingView data, MIT licensed, on your own machine, no account. Clone it tonight: github.com/mphinance/scanline
I almost did not give scanline away. Then I remembered I would have nothing to sell if TradingView had not handed me the data for free first. So here it is, open source. Pay it forward.

Three doors, one market. TraderDaddy Pro is the full cockpit. Trader Lady is the $7.99 chat analyst who reads options flow in plain English. scanline is the free screener you build yourself. Pick the one that fits how you work.
If a screener cannot tell you which factor lit up, drop it. scanline breaks every rank into a weighted z-score across momentum, value, quality, growth, and low-vol. Free, on TradingView data.
